decision.reason: The only prose evidence, [ev-51e7bc07959c], is a one-line release-note title that points to PR #6418. It doesn't name the schema path or CRD version, doesn't say whether this is a new optional field or kubelet settings moved from another resource, and doesn't say what happens to operators who do nothing. The CRD validator compared the schemas [ev-8998581760b8, ev-451bd6a12e72] and refuted the simple "field added" reading, because EC2NodeClass spec.kubelet already existed in the source release. So what actually changed (for example, a new served version or a relocation) is unknown. We need the PR or an upgrade/migration guide excerpt, or a per-version schema diff, that says what was added where and whether existing kubelet configuration elsewhere is affected.
